mapper.sql: id, exam_record_id, question_id, user_answer, is_correct, score, teacher_comment, graded_by, graded_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM answer_record WHERE exam_record_id = #{recordId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO answer_record ( exam_record_id, question_id, user_answer, is_correct, score, teacher_comment, graded_by, graded_time, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{examRecordId}, #{questionId}, #{userAnswer}, #{isCorrect}, #{score}, #{teacherComment}, #{gradedBy}, #{gradedTime}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE answer_record SET user_answer = #{userAnswer}, is_correct = #{isCorrect}, score = #{score}, teacher_comment = #{teacherComment}, graded_by = #{gradedBy}, graded_time = #{gradedTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
